page.title: Reading test generator
page.subtitle: Create a reading test with a text and task types that match the selected level and topic.

fields.promptInstructions: Write instructions for the AI here
fields.topicHelp: Example: A short text about school, football, nature, family life, or daily activities.
fields.feedbackModeHelp: This controls which generated guidance is shown here in the builder. At the moment, the teacher still receives the full submission regardless.

flow.title: Timer
flow.description: Choose the time for the reading test. When the test is submitted, the actual time used is shown and used to calculate words read per minute. If time runs out, the test ends automatically and is sent for assessment.
flow.showQuestionsAfterReadingHelp: The student reads first, then gets the tasks.

timer.help: For most cases, set the timer in minutes and only adjust seconds when needed.

taskTypes.title: Task types
taskTypes.description: The generator currently creates the classic reading test tasks first. You can also include
taskTypes.descriptionAfter: immediately, and add more task types manually below.

messages.tasksDirty: The text has changed. Check the tasks before saving.
messages.noTasks: No tasks yet. Generate a reading test first.

quota.usedOfLimit: You have used {used} of {limit} this month

builder.title: Reading test builder
builder.readingText: Your own or generated text is dispayed here
builder.textHelp: Review the text and tasks before you continue to finishing.
builder.fillInWordExample: Example: The children saw a black _____ that said meow.
builder.shortAnswerHelp: Short written response from the student.

stepStatus.step1Body: Choose level, language, text length, and topic. The generator creates both the reading text and the reading test tasks.
stepStatus.textReadyBody: Next, review the tasks. You can edit questions, options, and correct answers before continuing.
stepStatus.tasksReadyBody: Next step is finishing. There you can do the final setup before using the reading test.

sections.generateReadingTestBody: Choose level, language, text length, topic, and which task types to include.
sections.generateAiTextTitle: Generate AI text for reading test
sections.reviewTasksBody: The generated tasks can be adjusted here. Task types and logic stay the same as before.
sections.enableTaskEditorFirst: Generate a reading test first to enable task editing.
sections.goToFinishingBody: Continue from here to final setup and finishing for the reading test.
sections.readyToFinishBody: When the text and tasks are ready, you can continue to finishing.
